descr: The Cicada app provides real‑time subtitles, bilingual transcripts and AI‑powered meeting minutes on macOS, Windows, Linux and Android.
paragrafi: Cicada, released by wquguru, is a free open‑source tool that adds live subtitles, simultaneous interpretation and AI‑generated meeting summaries to any call or stream.

It runs on macOS 14.4+, Windows 10 (x64/ARM64), Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 and Android 10+, with separate installers for Apple‑silicon, Intel, Linux and Android available on the project’s website and GitHub releases.
Features include bilingual text records, searchable minutes, speaker‑identification, on‑the‑fly correction of mis‑recognized terms, and optional voice cloning for simultaneous translation.
All recordings and transcripts stay on the local machine; only text sent to translation services leaves the device, and the app does not collect analytics or run its own servers.
perche: Cicada lets users conduct multilingual meetings without paying for commercial transcription services, supporting privacy‑first workflows by keeping data local. It also offers a free alternative for teams that need cross‑platform live captioning and AI‑driven note‑taking, complementing the growing ecosystem of free chat models listed on FreeLLMArena.
